title: Boundary collar composition leaves one explicit compact residual rectangle

residual_domain.regularity: The Gaussian variance is at least 1/32 and the outer radius is finite; c=0 is the Rademacher face and z=1 is the finite three-point face.
residual_domain.remaining_method: Validated interval branch-and-bound on the closed residual rectangle, with every box pruned or included in a certified optimizer enclosure.

scope_guard: This is boundary exclusion and domain reduction for one scalar trial family at q=1/1024. It supplies no unrestricted field infimum, continuum physical state, source-owned action, prediction, or confirmation.
